reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text (p0066, independent-contractor/no-agency clause) contains no non-solicit, no-hire or inducement restriction, so the preferred position (no non-solicit binding Customer) is satisfied.
No redline or counterparty comment is proposed, which is correct for a compliant finding; the rendered text is identical to the original.

The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are non-probative here because they only apply where a non-solicit exists; their failure is consistent with the absence of any such covenant.
Rationale reasonably documents the search terms and the alternative employment-related provisions reviewed, providing adequate internal evidence for retention.
